title: Unveiling the mechanism of lithium-mediated nitrogen reduction via operando X-ray scattering in a flow cell with hydrogen oxidation
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06529A, Paper
Niklas H. Deissler, J. Bjarke V. Mygind, Valerie A. Niemann, Jakob B. Pedersen, Valentin Vinci, Shaofeng Li, Xianbiao Fu, Thomas F. Jaramillo, Jakob Kibsgaard, Jakub Drnec, Ib Chorkendorff
Operando GI WAXS in a flow cell with HOR revealed LiNH2 as the only stable crystalline intermediate in the lithium mediated nitrogen reduction reaction (Li-NRR) and the unique solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) formed by diglyme electrolytes.
